C1157.title: Major Loopholes Found in 'Teen Mode' on Short-Video Platforms
C1157.summary: Nandu reporters found that some online platforms had significant gaps in minor online safety protection. WeChat Channels could reset a password through SMS verification to disable youth mode, and some software could disable youth mode through uninstalling and reinstalling. These findings show that youth mode, if relying only on local settings or weak verification flows, can be bypassed and may fail to provide stable protection.

references.title: Huge Loopholes in 'Youth Mode'! Some Short Video Platforms Skirt the Rules
